note: Four separate sites strung along 1.3 km of Broad Mountain Road, an unpaved ridge-top forest road reached from Upper Strasburg Road by Bear Valley Road; all are in full sun and in sight of the road. BV004 Pipeline East and BV005 Pipeline West are mown strips of a pipeline right-of-way on either side of the road, 100 m apart: BV004 has a loop track to pull through, BV005 is a parallel pull-off. BV007 Broad Mountain West is an open grass-and-gravel lot about 40 m across, 280 m farther north-east, also parallel. BV008 Clarks Knob is a grass triangle in the fork of Broad Mountain Road and Clarks Knob Road, 0.9 km beyond BV007, pull-through. BV008 is closed for evaluation and maintenance: as of 2026-11-10 none of its nights can be booked through 2026-12-31, while nights from 2027-01-01 are on sale. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
